figures.title: Fallopian tube: OVGP1 immunohistochemistry
figures.caption: Fallopian tube tissue stained for oviductal glycoprotein 1 (OVGP1). Brown: OVGP1 protein. Blue: cell nuclei (hematoxylin counterstain).
figures.alt: Microscope image of fallopian tube tissue with OVGP1 protein stained brown and cell nuclei stained blue.
figures.credit: Image from the Human Protein Atlas 25.1 (proteinatlas.org): OVGP1 immunohistochemistry in fallopian tube, https://images.proteinatlas.org/62205/142921_A_8_7_rna_selected.jpg. CC BY 4.0.
